en: We went to Paris last year.

tr: Paris’e şu ana kadar iki kere gittik.
en: We have gone to Paris twice so far.
We hadn't gone to Paris before we moved to London.
Ali watched the movie yesterday.
Ali has already watched the movie.
Ali had watched the movie before us.
We ate dinner at seven o'clock.
We have just eaten.
We had eaten food before they arrived.

tr: Geçen hafta sonu partide onunla tanıştım.
en: I met him at the party last weekend.
I have met him a few times.

tr: Birlikte çalışmaya başlamadan önce onunla tanışmamıştım.
en: I hadn't met him before we started working together.
He read the book last night.
He has read the book many times.
He had read the book before the exam.
They did their homework yesterday.
They have just done their homework.
They had done their homework before they entered the lesson.

tr: Geçen hafta yeni bir telefon aldı.
en: He bought a new phone last week.

tr: Beş yıldır yeni bir telefon almadı.
en: He hasn't bought a new phone for five years.

tr: İndirim bitmeden önce bir telefon almıştı.
en: He had bought a phone before the sales finished.
The movie started at eight o'clock.
The movie has already started.
The movie had started when we arrived.
He wrote a poem last night.
He has written many poems until today.

tr: Teslim tarihinden önce bir şiir yazmıştı.
en: He had written a poem before the deadline.
I left home at eight o'clock in the morning.
I have left my keys at home.
I had left before they arrived.
He broke the window two days ago.
He has just broken his phone.
He had broken his phone before he paid for it.

tr: Geçen yıl yeni bir ev inşa ettiler.
en: They built a new house last year.

tr: Şimdiye kadar üç ev inşa ettiler.
en: They have built three houses until now.

tr: Fırtına çıkmadan önce bir tane ev inşa etmişlerdi.
en: They had built one house before the storm started.
The teacher chose me yesterday.
They haven't chosen successful students for ten years.

tr: Riskleri bilmeden önce o yolu seçmişti.
en: He had chosen that way before he knew the risks.

tr: Bu sabah çok fazla kahve içtim.
en: I drank too much coffee this morning.
I have drunk four cups of coffee today.
I had drunk coffee before the interview.
I felt tired yesterday.

tr: O zamandan beri daha iyi hissediyorum.
en: I have felt better since then.

tr: İstanbul’a taşınmadan önce de aynı şekilde hissetmiştim.
en: I had felt the same way before I moved to Istanbul.
We flew to Berlin last year.
We have flown to Europe twice.
We had flown before the weather got worse.

tr: Ali beş dakika önce merdivenlerden düştü.
en: Ali fell down the stairs five minutes ago.
I have fallen many times.
He had fallen once before.
I forgot the password yesterday.
I have just forgotten my name.
I hadn't forgotten anything before the accident.

tr: Geçen hafta bana bir hediye verdi.
en: He gave me a gift last week.

tr: Ben bugüne dek arkadaşlarıma birçok hediye verdim.
en: I have given many gifts to my friends until today.
He had given it before I asked.
The plants grew quickly last year.

tr: Bitkiler bu yıl daha hızlı büyüdü.
en: The plants have grown faster this year.
They hadn't grown potatoes before the war.

tr: İki dakika önce tuhaf bir ses duydum.
en: I heard a strange sound two minutes ago.
I have heard the song before.
I hadn't heard the song before you.
I rode a horse last summer.
I have ridden a horse many times.
I hadn't ridden a horse before I took lessons.
The phone rang at midnight.
Has the phone just rung?
The phone had rung before you came.

tr: Ali bu sabah beş kilometre koştu.
en: Ali ran five kilometers this morning.
I haven't run for three years.
He had run before us.
They sold their house last year.
They have already sold their car.
They had sold their house before the crisis.
He sent the email yesterday.
I have just sent the email.
He had sent the email before noon.
I sang at school yesterday.
I have sung that song many times.
I had sung before the show.
He spoke clearly two minutes ago.
I haven't spoken to the manager yet.
He had spoken to me before the meeting.
